requirements: Claude Code on Windows, Mac or Linux; the first run installs its free tools (Python, FFmpeg, a local Kokoro voice). ElevenLabs is optional.

preview.description: A 48-second flat 2D cartoon story reel of Maradona's Hand of God, 1986: every fact checked first, comic freezes, a TV replay with an arrow, a voice-over and word-timed captions.

video.caption: Example by Theo, made with this skill.
